hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); echo "$f" | grep -q "/frontend/" && (cd /Users/ivan/Documents/workplace/claude-hackathon-amsterdam/frontend && npx eslint --max-warnings=0 "$f" 2>&1 | head -30) || echo "SKIP: not a frontend file"'

bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); echo "$f" | grep -q "/backend/" && (cd /Users/ivan/Documents/workplace/claude-hackathon-amsterdam/backend && source venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; python -m pytest tests/ -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -20) || echo "SKIP: not a backend file"'

bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); basename "$f" | grep -qE "^\.env$|^\.env\." && echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Writing to .env files is blocked to prevent committing secrets.\"}" || echo "SKIP: not an env file"'
